purpose: Hold distinct simulation, worker and selective-diarization methods for staged offline and later native CM5 validation.

compositions.A0_D1_E0: Sherpa ASR + Nemotron 3 diarization + ReDimNet identity
compositions.A2_D1_E0: Nemotron English ASR + Nemotron 3 diarization + ReDimNet identity

optional_control: Anonymous E0 bypass; no persistent personal naming claim.
retired: TitaNet E1: preserve prior evidence; no new work.

delivery.unpaced: Saved-file throughput only; never a live-latency result.
delivery.paced_1x: Monotonic-clock delivery: sample n is available no earlier than n/sample_rate.
delivery.paced_05x: Half input arrival rate; diagnose whether extra compute headroom clears the backlog.
delivery.paced_2x: Twice input arrival rate; controlled overload, not a real-world speed claim.
delivery.jitter_1x: 1x source with deterministic extra arrival delay 0/20/80/200ms, seed recorded; never deliver before source time.
delivery.burst_1x: Accumulate 2s source, release buffered frames in a burst, repeat; preserve source indices and measure added latency.
delivery.endurance_30m: At least 30 minutes of causally delivered saved audio; declared joins/epochs and duty cycle.
delivery.endurance_60m: 60-minute finalist run, including dense continuous speech and silence; native target after admission.

workers.threads_ordered: Existing separate ASR and one ordered stateful D1 lane; no guarantee of priority without timing evidence.
workers.serial_control: Serialized ASR/speaker control to quantify interaction and publication delay.
workers.process_isolated: Separate bounded ASR/D1 processes with shared immutable audio references; include IPC/copy/RSS cost.
workers.embedding_on_demand: ASR plus one ordered D1, E0 only for new/changed/uncertain identity on eligible clean speech windows.
workers.two_overlapping_diarizers: Two independent overlapping-window D1 workers; separate caches/epochs, explicit cross-window slot/identity reconciliation.
workers.independent_sessions_pool: Worker pool over unrelated saved sessions; measures total throughput only, never single-conversation acceleration.

gate.exact_digital_zero: Only all-zero PCM runs with declared pre-roll/hangover; not equivalent to acoustic silence.
gate.energy_minus55: 20ms RMS >= -55dBFS, 200ms pre-roll, 400ms hangover; prior model-free analysis exists.
gate.energy_minus45: 20ms RMS >= -45dBFS, same padding; prior analysis lost more quiet speech.
gate.adaptive_energy: Causal rolling noise estimate with floor/ceiling and hysteresis, frozen before held-out evaluation; no future/global normalization.
gate.lightweight_vad: Existing locally available, hash-pinned speech VAD; include its measured CPU and wake-up cost.
gate.vad_or_energy: Positive VAD OR conservative energy support; uncertain/missing cue retains audio.
gate.energy_or_asr_022: Energy OR nonempty partial/final ASR support available by a 220ms decision deadline; current composition ASR only.
gate.energy_or_asr_2: Same positive-only support with 2s deadline; caption publication never waits for gate.
gate.energy_vad_asr_union: Union of causal positive cues; silence only when all present cues agree and hold duration is met.
gate.asr_only_negative_control: Diagnostic only: no recognized tokens does not establish silence; never deploy this alone.
gate.xvf_positive_fallback: Later measured XVF3800 speech energy/direction as positive support plus software cues; stale/missing hardware cue cannot veto speech.

chunk.ultralow_032: Existing supported native 0.32s profile; prior evidence suggests greater compute cost.
chunk.offline_304: Supported 30.4s offline-style buffer; throughput/accuracy contrast with explicit minimum buffering latency, not prompt streaming.

queue.bounded_fifo: Bound source duration, outstanding compute, and oldest pending label separately; overflow is explicit Unknown/unanalyzed.
queue.recent_first_epoch: If overloaded, declare skipped intervals and a new track epoch; restart near present with measured context warm-up, do not reuse uncertain identity.
queue.uncertain_revisit: Keep ordered primary D1; separate bounded retrospective jobs only for uncertain spans, with explicit context and independent state. Never reorder pushes into one cache.

state.continuous: All samples in source order, unchanged native state.
state.shadow: Log proposed keep/skip decisions while feeding every sample. Measures cue errors; no compute saving claimed.
state.speech_islands_reset: Apply gate only after shadow qualification; fresh state/epoch per admitted island and explicit identity reacquisition.
state.compacted_timeline: Experimental applied skip with reversible source/model interval mapping and validated cache policy; model boundaries crossing a gap stay split/unknown.

execution_order: Freeze exact source/model/runtime/config and matched budgets
Shadow gating on all eligible existing scenarios, holding truth separate
Selected actual paced implementations with semantic/state checks
New held-out real-world validation after reconnection
promotion_rule: Only reviewed evidence promotes an entry; terminal success, modeled speed or this catalog never accept N4/N5. No automatic Cartesian sweep.
metrics: cpWER or speaker-attributed WER where references support it
False named assignment and Unknown/pending fraction
Label corrections and stale pending age
Inference calls, retained duration, gate/fusion/context CPU time
Service RTF and wall-time effective RTF including all costs
Peak per-process and total RSS, CPU, thread counts
Native target clocks, thermals and throttling
Skipped/degraded source intervals and identity epoch changes
Normal worker closure and source/hash parity
mandatory_scope: Maintain two-logical-CPU Windows admission and GPU off; future CM5 allocations require actual admission. Unknown cues retain audio; no hardware, training or enrollment during offline campaign.
